snippet.title: Pathogen-X Demo - Arcade Mode Gameplay
snippet.description:
Full playthrough of an Arcade Mode run in the newest version [5.3.3] of Pathogen-X.
- - - - - -
Pathogen-X is an action-oriented survival horror game inspired by later Resident Evil games as well as others such as Dino Crisis and Deep Fear. It is currently in development independently by 2 people. Support the project here:
https://sodaraptor.itch.io/pathogen-x
https://ko-fi.com/sodaraptor
https://twitter.com/sodaraptor_dev
